how.claude-code: opens the project folder: .claude/skills is loaded as project skills (Dremzo Code Claude engine, FX AI chat in Houdini)
how.codex: opens the project folder: .agents/skills (generated mirror, same content as .claude/skills)
how.dremzo-code get_skill: the dremzo MCP tool get_skill lists this project's skills for the chat's project and reads one by name (Gemini, GPT, Antigravity, Claude)

skills.name: houdini-builder-script
skills.description: Use when writing a Python Shell script that creates Houdini nodes for Plug - a "rebuild everything" builder, a patch that inserts or rewires nodes, or any "paste this and it builds the setup" request (เหมือน FX Template).

skills.name: houdini-flower-endless-blossom
skills.description: Use whenever Plug wants a procedural flower / petal / blossom / bloom in Houdini - petals that open on a rig, a blossom that keeps growing in a loop, petals falling with Vellum, procedural petal textures in Copernicus, a Karma flower look - or asks to reuse, extend, re-render or version the "Endless Blossom → procedural flower" technique on the Houdini Snippet Shelf. Also use for any Feather-tool petal, golden-angle copy loop, time-offset blossom, "endless loop" of cached sim copies, or a flower-shaped Vellum emission even when the word flower is not said. It routes to the builder/verify/publish skills and carries the measured traps.

skills.name: houdini-hython-verify
skills.description: Use when a Houdini builder script, VEX wrangle or .hipnc fix needs checking before it is handed to Plug, when debugging one of his .hip files ("ช่วยดูไฟล์นี้หน่อย"), or when a claim like "matches the sim" / "0 error" needs a number behind it.

skills.name: houdini-shelf-publish
skills.description: Use when adding a new technique, a new version, or a changed file to Plug's Houdini Snippet Shelf, or when he says "เพิ่มเข้า Snippet Shelf" / "add this to the shelf" after a Houdini fix, VEX snippet or builder script.
